title: Questions 168-171 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
Meridian Language Bridge

Are you meeting partners from abroad? Specializing in conference interpreting and legal depositions, Meridian helps you be understood in the room. As we mark our 25th anniversary, we are proud to go on serving clients with our outstanding interpreting services.

Our People

Our staff interpreters have a minimum of 10 years of professional experience. In addition, our senior supervisor, who checks every final transcript, holds more than 18 years of experience in the field. We currently work in over 40 languages, including Vietnamese, Mandarin, and Arabic.

Our Promise

We are committed to being transparent about costs. Under our fixed-fee policy, we always stand by the estimate given at the initial stage of an assignment. Even if a session runs longer than expected, you will never be billed for the extra hours.

Contact Us

To see the full list of languages we work in, please visit www.meridianbridge.com. To ask for a free estimate, please telephone our client team on 555-0733.
